alternatives.option: only recording it in the JSON

constraints: Pre-registered thresholds must not move after seeing results
Probe must remain read-only — re-verified by mtime+size hash after adding the sqlite open
context: Probe v2/v3: excluded archive-loop junk, then fixed live-board source after Dave caught the instrument reporting zero warnings a dashboard was showing
rationale: the failure mode was silent for two versions and a visible source line makes a wrong-source reading self-evident in the console output someone pastes back
summary: Chose to print the resolved live-board source in the probe header ('live board from: twining.db') rather than only recording it in the JSON
